# List Command Tests — verify list output format and filtering

# --- Empty KB produces no output ---

exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and adr templates'

exec akb list
! stdout .

# --- List shows pages after writing ---

stdin ../note-input.md
exec akb write alpha-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/alpha-note.md'

stdin ../note2-input.md
exec akb write beta-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/beta-note.md'

stdin ../adr-input.md
exec akb write decision-one.md
stdout 'Written to kb/decisions/decision-one.md'

# List output contains page paths
exec akb list
stdout 'decisions/decision-one.md'
stdout 'notes/alpha-note.md'
stdout 'notes/beta-note.md'

# List output does NOT contain index.md or log.md
exec akb list
! stdout 'index.md'
! stdout 'log.md'

# List output does NOT have kb/ prefix
exec akb list
! stdout 'kb/'

# List output is alphabetical
exec akb list
stdout 'decisions/decision-one.md'
stdout 'notes/alpha-note.md'
stdout 'notes/beta-note.md'

# --- List after delete removes the page ---

exec akb delete notes/alpha-note.md
stdout 'Deleted kb/notes/alpha-note.md'

exec akb list
! stdout 'alpha-note'
stdout 'notes/beta-note.md'
stdout 'decisions/decision-one.md'

-- note-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Alpha Note
summary: First test note
tags: test
---
Alpha note content.

-- note2-input.md --
---
type: note
title: Beta Note
summary: Second test note
tags: test
---
Beta note content.

-- adr-input.md --
---
type: adr
title: Decision One
status: proposed
deciders: team
summary: A test decision
tags: [test]
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
## Context

List coverage needs a page of the decision type. The listing walks every tracked page and prints its path, so a decision record appears exactly like a note. See [[alpha-note]] for the note that shares the listing.

## Decision

ADR content here. The decision is listed under its type directory and sorts alphabetically with the notes.

## Consequences

Recorded. Deleting the page removes it from the listing on the next call.
